items.name: Arrogance +2
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to all mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn. The headband also grants skill ranks as a headband of vast intelligence.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor, fox's cunning, owl's wisdom; Cost 8,000 gp

items.name: The Operative +2
items.description:
The tattoo grants the bearer an enhancement bonus to Dexterity of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn.
The item also provides a +2 insight bonus to stealth.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, Cat's Grace; Cost 2,500 gp

items.name: Amulet of Natural Armor +1
items.description:
This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales—toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator's caster level must be at least three times the amulet's bonus; Cost 1,000 gp

items.name: Divine Scion +2 (Wis & Cha)
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two mental ability scores of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tatoo is worn.
These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo is created and cannot be changed.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor, owl's wisdom; Cost 6,000 gp

items.name: Black Sovereign +2
items.description:
This tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to all physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, bear's endurance, bull's strength, cat's grace; Cost 9,000 gp

items.name: Godkiller's Wisdom +2
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Wisdom of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
It also causes the bearer's wisdom bonus to be added to their initiative rolls.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, owl's wisdom; Cost 2,500 gp

items.name: The Timestopper
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Charisma of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
The item also allows the bearer to add their charisma bonus to initiative checks.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, Eagle's Splendor; Cost 2,500 gp

items.name: The Gunslinger +2 Dex & Con
items.description:
This tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two physical ability scores of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn. These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo created and cannot be changed.
It also grants a +2 competence bonus on all dex-based skill checks.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, bear's endurance, cat's grace; Cost 6,000 gp

items.name: The Redeemer +2
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to strength and charisma, +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo is created and cannot be changed.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor, Bull's Strength Cost 6,000 gp

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description:
This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus; Cost 500 gp

items.name: The Undying +2
items.description:
This tattoo depicts a golden haired angel with black feather wings and a flaming greatsword. It grants the bearer an enhancement bonus to Constitution of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
It also increases the amount gained from regeneration spells such as Infernal Healing or Celestial Healing by 1 per round.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, Bear's Endurance; Cost 2,500 gp

items.name: Rocket Dwarf +2
items.description:
This tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two physical ability scores of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn. These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo is created and cannot be changed.
It also grants a +4 competence bonus to CMD.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, bear's endurance, bull's strength; Cost 6,000 gp

items.name: The Librarian +2 (Int & Wis)
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two mental ability scores of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo is created and cannot be changed. If the tattoo grants a bonus to Intelligence, it also grants skill ranks as a headband of vast intelligence.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, fox's cunning, owl's wisdom; Cost 6,000 gp

items.name: Warlord's Wife +2
items.description:
This tattoogrants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two physical ability scores of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn. These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo is created and cannot be changed.
The item also increases all your CMB attempts by +2 competence.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, bull's strength, cat's grace; Cost 6,000 gp

items.name: The Show Off +2
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Strength of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
It also grants +4 on all strength ability checks.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, bull's strength; Cost 2,500 gp

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description:
This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.
ConstructionRequirements Forge Ring, shield of faith, caster must be of a level at least three times higher than the bonus of the ring; Cost 1,000 gp
